atoms.text: It’s the early morning of an important day: Antonia has a big speech to give in assembly. She’s feeling a little nervous and her uncle is trying to calm her down.

instruction.text: Follow the dialogue and select the fitting missing sayings and expressions.

atoms.b: Good morning. The early ((++bird --bug --bat)) catches the worm. How are you feeling today?
Morning... I’ve had ((++butterflies_in_my_stomach --ants_on_my_head)) for the past week. How can I still feel so nervous?
Feeling nervous is normal, but you have absolutely nothing to worry about. You were ((++born --fried)) to give this speech.
I know, I know... But what if it gets out of ((++hand --mouth --foot))? What if I black out in front of the entire audience or something?
Don’t worry, this is going to be ((++a_piece_of_cake --an_icebreaker)) for you.
Maybe... anyway, you have ((++bigger_fish_to_fry --the_last_straw)) today: don’t you have an important meeting?
Yes, but that’s not my biggest fish to fry right now. You need to understand that you got this. This is not ((++rocket --aeroplane --rock_n'_roll)) science for you.
Thank you for your support. I really appreciate it. I do have to get ready now though.
